analysis: Both units are unchanged BASE excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (base lines 1217-2023). The file_changes map (range_map_complete=true) puts the base changes at lines 3, 5221-5224, 5245 and 5321, so nothing in these excerpts was modified. They describe GLM media handling, calibration, CBv2 timing, deadlines and MTP. Security-relevant content is pre-existing. Media requests are excluded from prefix lookup (base line 1232; relates to T-041/SEC-035). ChunkBatcher drops frames when no session sink is bound, but it does not enforce request-to-session identity across reconnects (base lines 1548-1555; TB-002, a documented pre-existing limitation). Prefix receipt correlation appears at base lines 1619-1624. None of these is changed here. The PR's actual changes are documentation only, visible in the patch excerpt. First, a new paragraph (head 3528-3536) says the cluster service heartbeat file is named by DARKBLOOM_CLUSTER_MEMBER_HEALTH_FILE and the supervisor accepts only beats carrying the service's own PID. Second, cluster runtime facts (head ~5230-5235) now come from approval digests that a signed release computes and registers (cluster_runtime), and guided setup matches a served approval against the installed app. That second change implies a provenance shift for approvals: from locally computed values to release-registered ones. Integration should check it against TB-011/T-054 (qualified build identity) and TB-013/T-061 (served artifacts) using the head-side units and the referenced provider-release.md. The local heartbeat file is under operator control and not a security boundary per TB-003. The units in this batch show no regression.
